decisions.notes: Lead: keep the row, not REMOVE. The instrument is titled and structured as a moratorium on accepting and processing applications (Sec. 2), and its sponsor describes it as a pause until listed conditions are met. Research-process rule: a no-sunset ban is recorded when the instrument itself is framed as a moratorium. It also adds a permanent 'prohibited use' classification (Sec. 5), so it is borderline and should be handled under the same coordinator policy as other no-end-date rows (e.g. Ida County). It remains pending: no final adoption found. If it is adopted in the current form, consider duration_kind 'indefinite' (already set) and an outcome note on the prohibited-use clause.

new_candidates.notes: Lead (QA1 IA): a real pause chain distinct from ia-emmet-county-2024 (wind) and ia-emmet-county-2026 (data centers). The chain starts with Resolution 25-05 (Jan. 2025), not 25-36 as QA1 thought. Resolution 25-36's signature line reads 'September 30, 2024', evidently a typo for 2025 (it was posted Sept. 2025 and continues the 2025-09-30 expiry). The later resolutions re-state the moratorium each time but continue one pause, so this is one row, per the codebook's extension rule. Jurisdiction name matches existing Emmet County rows; the generated id needs a suffix.
